title: How to Prepare for a Software License Renewal
summary: A renewal-planning checklist covering license quantities, contract dates, product editions and quotation requirements.

body.text: License renewals often involve several independent decisions: what the organization uses, which products it is entitled to buy, when coverage expires and what term it wants next. Planning helps the purchasing team request accurate quotations.

items: Document each publisher, product, edition, subscription identifier and relevant contract or agreement.
Review current assigned licenses, actual users and anticipated changes in seat counts.
Confirm the expiration date and any required notice or renewal window.
Identify schools, agencies, departments and locations that need coverage.
Separate optional feature requests from required functionality.
Ask the authorized supplier to verify eligibility, license terms, product availability and any transfer requirements.

body.text: Include the desired term, quantities, renewal date, response deadline and quote validity. Clarify whether taxes, support and provisioning are included rather than assuming a prior package continues unchanged.
Build in time for internal authorization, security or legal review and any procurement requirements. Never assume a renewal is automatic or that an account-specific price is guaranteed.
